summary: Frontend-only verification of mobile SIGN IN + drawer account row on BDS Marvel /stays. All four scenarios in the review request PASSED: (1) mobile logged-out header shows header-signin-link; drawer shows drawer-signin-link + drawer-stays-link; tapping drawer SIGN IN navigates to /stays/trips and shows the login panel. (2) Mobile logged-in (fresh guest registered via /api/auth/register) shows account-menu-button in header (header-signin-link hidden), drawer shows drawer-account-name='Test Guest', drawer-trips-link and drawer-logout; YOUR TRIPS routes to /stays/trips; LOG OUT returns to logged-out state with SIGN IN re-appearing. (3) Desktop 1920x1080 /stays shows SIGN IN when logged out and avatar menu + drawer account row ('BDS Marvel Admin' + YOUR TRIPS + LOG OUT) when logged in as admin; nav items + account row + footer render in drawer. (4) Regression: drawer still opens on mobile stay detail page /stays/home/living-studio with z-index 900 (overlays reserve bar area); drawer open/close works cleanly on homepage desktop + mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js has grown large (Header + drawer + many sub-components in a single file) — consider splitting Header/Drawer into their own modules per the >700-line guideline.

The regression check for the mobile stay detail reserve bar could not locate a '.reserve-bar' selector programmatically — behavior visually looks fine (drawer z-index=900) but adding a data-testid='stay-reserve-bar' would make future regressions deterministic.
test_credentials: Admin info.bdsmarvel@gmail.com / <redacted> (used for desktop logged-in drawer check). Guest registered on the fly via /api/auth/register and cleaned up after test.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST_ guest (test_guest_yv2nsl@example.com) via /api/auth/register; row removed from users collection post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile drawer account row (SIGN IN · STAYS when logged out, name + YOUR TRIPS · LOG OUT when logged in) and header-signin-link visibility on mobile are verified across /stays, /stays/trips, /stays/home/living-studio, and homepage. useAuth() reads from GET /api/auth/me (httpOnly cookies). If adding further tests, prefer data-testid=stay-reserve-bar for the mobile reserve bar regression.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration was verification only; all requested behaviors render correctly on both viewports and in both auth states.
